message: Year-specific climate input, the validation split and the covariate set determine how much physics + residual ML gains over recalibrated Stefan; the gain is largest where Stefan errs most.
medium: Scientific Reports, double column, 180 mm wide, fixed canvas (no tight bbox)

style.font: FreeSans 7 pt (ticks 6.5 pt, heat-map values 6 pt), panel letters 8 pt bold, all text black (white only inside dark heat-map cells)
style.lines: axes 0.5 pt black, data 0.9 pt, reference/zero 0.5 pt grey #808080, no grid, top/right spines off
style.methods: Stefan (source coeff.) #9A9A9A thin; Stefan (recalibrated) #0072B2; Physics + residual ML #D55E00; Direct ML #1A1A1A dashed, open markers
style.regions: grey shades + markers: Alaska #1A1A1A circle, Lena Delta #5C5C5C square, Canada (NW) #949494 triangle
style.heat_map: cmcrameri vik, symmetric about 0; black outline = 95% CI excludes 0; light grey hatching = insufficient data; values 6 pt

layout: row 1: a (3 region panels, slope chart mean vs observation-year climate input) | b (3 region panels, RMSE by validation split); row 2: c (horizontal interval plot by covariate set) | d (tercile heat map + colour bar + key). One method legend at the top, one region legend above c.

a.filter: scheme block, featset F8TS, forcing clim and year_obs; P1, R1 (catboost, lam 0.5), D0 (catboost)
a.years: labels 2010-2024 (Lena 2010-2022); mean climate = 2011-2024 ERA5-Land mean; year-specific = TDD to observation day

b.filter: forcing year_obs, featset F8TS; schemes random, block, year, block_year, region; P0, P1, R1 (catboost, lam 0.5), D0 (catboost)
b.out_of_range: values > 1.3 x max of the non-region splits are drawn on the top edge with the value printed

c.filter: scheme block, forcing year_obs, ref P1, method R1 catboost lam 0.5; modis_v6 (MODIS 2010-2024) preferred over featsets_v6 for F8TS, F8TS_M, F8TS_ALL, as in v6_numbers.py and v7_f4_results_core.py

d.filter: covariate != all; shown = n >= 30 cell-years and >= 5 blocks; excludes_0 from 2000 block-bootstrap resamples

qa: 2026-10-16 independent review (scientific-figure-reviewer): acceptable, no blocking issues; 12 plotted/printed values spot-checked against the source CSVs, all match; zero overlaps, no text below 6 pt; vector PDF/SVG with embedded FreeSans. Minor: in a, open/filled markers mean climate input (2011-2024 mean / observation year) for all three methods, while open markers mean Direct ML elsewhere; kept as specified because the x-tick labels state the input, caption should say so.

qa_automatic.checks: fig34_common.qa: font >= 6 pt, text-text overlap, text outside canvas, text over foreign axes, in-axes labels touching lines/markers; pdffonts: FreeSans/FreeSansBold embedded (CID TrueType); svg text kept as text

marker_rule: Stefan methods squares (as Fig. 5), ML methods circles; Direct ML open circles, dashed
